findings.message: The xsaves_xsavec_checked field is guarded by #ifndef __GENKSYMS__ in struct kvm_hv, but its usages in hyperv.c and x86.c are not. This will cause a compilation error during kABI tracking builds (make kabi-check), which compile the entire kernel with __GENKSYMS__=1 to verify struct layouts. While the patch fixes a kABI breakage by hiding the field from ABI checks, the unguarded references in the C source files introduce a build break in the same mode.

suse_upstream_verification.upstream_subject: KVM: x86: Give a hint when Win2016 might fail to boot due to XSAVES erratum
